reviews.name: Natasha Petersen
reviews.text: Delicious food and outstanding service! The café has a fantastic vintage music theme with vinyl records decorating the space, creating a warm and nostalgic atmosphere. A great spot to relax and enjoy a good meal.

reviews.name: Raushan Essop
reviews.text:
What an amazing restaurant. I loved the vibe. The food was great. I had the nacho burger and my wife had the one with the pineapple on, I forgot the name but it was so filling and delicious.
We also had brownie cake which was 10/10 for us.
Everyone's different but that was my opinion.

reviews.name: Zaida Da Silva Bastra
reviews.text:
Cute and cosy.
Friendly and helpful staff
Wifi available.

Menu has great options.
Decor and placement for what's on offer is great.
Games are available to play whilst there.

Tea and coffee selections at the entrance .

Didn't have to wait long and the food was delectable. The drinks were ok.

Recommended your place and my brother took mom & her sister this morning for breakfast.

I visited your site behind Kenilworth Centre about 2 years ago and enjoyed a delicious breakfast there.  The last picture is the sign from inside that space.

Will visit again!

reviews.name: Isa Isaacs
reviews.text: An updated menu just arrived. Thoroughly enjoyed the food at Cafe Crave. A nice cosy restaurant that is fully halal and has a variety of food on the menu from all day breakfast to burgers to light meals and desserts. I would highly recommend everyone to call and reserve a table. All the food is very tasty but if you want a big burger I'd recommend the double beef burger. You will not need to eat again for the remainder of the day. The chocolate cakes are heavenly. Awesome customer service from all staff. This is a great place to sit with family and/or friends be it for some cake and coffee or for a meal. There is even a games corner where you can play some Jenga, monopoly, Scrabble, Uno, Dominoes as well as take a crack at solving a rubic cube. Try them you will not be sorry. The restaurant can cater up to 75 people so it's nice and quaint for some corporate functions. All baked goods are done on a daily basis - always so fresh and so tasty. Also toilets are available and very clean
